summary: Shepherd (Loc 1), San Jacinto County: listed as gone; a 1947 survey description places its benchmark about 124 feet from an abandoned lookout tower. No build or current-site details found.

notes_for_editor: The tower-to-mark link is inferred. The 1947 description names an abandoned tower about 124 feet from the mark, and the mark's published position is close to the FFLA Loc 1 coordinates, but no source names the tower. The brief's San Jacinto county and gone status are both confirmed (FFLA; NGS STATE/COUNTY line). The 1935 date is the survey mark's monumenting date, not the tower's. Not used in the story: a pastmaps.com blurb (https://pastmaps.com/explore/us/texas/san-jacinto-county/shepherd) for a 1985 USGS Rayburn map says researchers can 'locate the Lookout Tower' in the Shepherd area; it does not say which site or whether the tower still stood. The Loc 1 and Loc 2 sites cannot be placed in time from the sources read. No photos added (the NGS page has none). Confidence medium: the abandonment rests on one 1947 survey text plus a coordinate match, and nothing describes the site today.
